close_reason: Added CalendarEvent.ical_component: Option<String> with explicit serde(rename='iCalComponent') and skip_serializing_if; 2 new tests; 57 tests pass; clippy clean
description: Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.7 defines iCalComponent as a CalendarEvent property: a Blob (base64 of the raw iCalendar VEVENT) that is returned only when explicitly requested via CalendarEvent/get properties=[iCalComponent]. Without this field, a CalendarEvent/get response including iCalComponent silently drops it. Add: pub ical_component: Option<String> with skip_serializing_if (base64-encoded blob). The type is String not Id because the spec says it's the iCalendar data directly, not a blobId. Note: verify in spec text whether this is a blobId or inline base64 before implementing.
title: Add CalendarEvent.iCalComponent field (calendars-26 §5.7)
